newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile issues new cadmium solicitation.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile issues new cadmium solicitation.

text.p: The Defense National Stockpile Center said it has issued a new solicitation for cadmium that comes into effect after the next offering, due on July 8.
Offers will be accepted under the old solicitation DLA-ABC-001 on July 8.

Under the new solicitation, DLA CADMIUM 002, Stockpile will seek sealed bids for approximately 935,908 lbs of cadmium for the remainder of the 1997 fiscal year. The minimum quantity bid for material has been reduced to 1,000 lbs.
The initial opening under the new soliciation will be July 23. If all the material is not sold, subsequent openings will be held the fourth Wednesday of each month until all the material is sold.
